description:
🔻 PRICE DROP ($300K → $290K)
What really happens:
• Down payment drops by only $1,000 (if putting 10% down)
• Monthly payment decreases about $45–$50/mo
• Savings over 5 years? Around $2,700
• Seller nets almost the same
→ Not bad — just not powerful.

💰 SELLER CONCESSION — $10,000 credit
Most buyers use this to buy down their interest rate.

That can reduce your rate by ~0.5% permanently.

📉 Interest rate buy-down example
Before buydown:
Rate: 6.5%
Payment: ≈ $1,900/mo

After buydown:
Rate: 6.0%
Payment: ≈ $1,780/mo

Actual savings:
• $120/month
• $1,440/year
• $7,200 saved in 5 years
• $20,000–$25,000 saved over life of loan 😳

A simple price drop can’t compete with that long-term impact.

PLUS:
✨ Appraisal stays at $300K
✨ You keep more cash at closing
✨ Seller still nets the same

Here’s the truth:
A price drop sounds flashy.
A seller concession actually saves you more money—and the numbers prove it every time. 💡

Buying in Killeen / Harker Heights / Fort Hood / Belton / Temple?
Don’t leave money on the table.

If you’re negotiating an offer right now, ask about concessions — not just discounts.
